description.value: You were there at the beginning of more lives than you can count, and also at some endings. The work required technical knowledge, steady hands, and the ability to remain calm when the people around you were not. Families trusted you completely during the most vulnerable hours they experienced, which meant you carried information about them that shaped how they behaved toward you long afterward.

system.startingEquipment:
Herbalism kit
common clothes
low boots
system.features: Trusted in Every Home: You have stood in households during their most private and frightening hours, and that trust does not expire. Common folk in rural settlements and small towns extend you a deference and openness that strangers rarely receive. You can find shelter, honest information, and practical assistance from ordinary families who would turn away adventurers on instinct but not someone who has helped bring lives into the world.
